days.file: Sandro Botticelli - St Augustin dans son cabinet de travail.jpg
days.title: Saint Augustine in His Study
days.alt: Augustine in a red robe sits at his desk beneath a vaulted niche, pen in hand over an open book.
days.look: Look again at Augustine bent over his book. What question has been waiting in your own heart?
days.license: Artist died 1510; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Gand, Juste de - Berruguete, Pedro - Saint Thomas d'Aquin, MI 651 ; Campana 387.jpg
days.title: Saint Thomas Aquinas
days.alt: St. Thomas Aquinas, a Dominican in a black cloak and cap, looks out with both hands raised in a teaching gesture.
days.look: Look again at Thomas's raised hands. What do you most want to understand, and for whose sake?
days.license: Artist died c. 1480; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.artist: Rupertsberg Scivias, illuminated under Hildegard of Bingen
days.title: The Cosmos (vision from Scivias)
days.alt: A gold and blue oval of stars, sun, moon and planets circles the small earth at its center.
days.look: Look again at the stars and planets ringed around the earth. What do they say to you of their Maker?
days.license: Anonymous 12th-century illumination; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: Saint Albert the Great (Frankfurt Dominican altar)
days.alt: St. Albert the Great, a Dominican in black and white, glances down with one hand raised beneath the words ‘Bishop, Universal Doctor.’
days.look: Look again at the friar’s raised hand, as if about to explain what he has seen. Where does your study meet your faith?
days.license: Artist died 1524; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: Christ Pantocrator
days.alt: Christ looks straight out from a gold halo, with large dark eyes and a calm, steady face.
days.look: Look again at the face of Christ. What would it be to trust that in him all things hold together?
days.license: Anonymous 6th-century icon; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: The Road to Emmaus
days.alt: Two travelers walk beside a robed stranger along a sunlit forest path.
days.look: Look again at the third traveler walking between the two. When has Scripture warmed your heart on a road like this?
days.license: Artist died 1909; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Philippe de Champaigne - La Cène (Louvre, INV 1124).jpg
days.title: The Last Supper
days.alt: Jesus, in pink and blue, sits at a white-draped table with apostles pressed close on both sides as he speaks.
days.look: Look again at the apostles leaning close as Jesus speaks. How could you make a quiet home for him this week?
days.license: Artist died 1674; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Benozzo Gozzoli - St Augustine Teaching in Rome (scene 6, south wall) - WGA10290.jpg
days.title: Saint Augustine Teaching in Rome
days.alt: Augustine sits enthroned in a hall and teaches a crowd of students, some of them holding books.
days.look: Look again at the students gathered around the teacher. Who is your learning for?
days.license: Artist died 1497; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: L'Apôtre Paul à sa table de travail.jpg
days.title: Saint Paul at His Writing Desk
days.alt: The aged apostle Paul, bearded and in a brown robe, rests a hand on a great book beside his desk.
days.look: Look again at Paul's hand on the book and his far-off gaze. What do you wish to thank God for tonight?
days.license: Artist died 1669; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)
